description: The image displays a false-colour satellite view of an agricultural and semi-natural landscape. The coloration, with vibrant greens and reddish-browns, is characteristic of an infrared or similar band combination, often used to highlight vegetation characteristics. A prominent winding light-coloured road or track traverses the central and lower parts of the image, with several small, bright white structures, likely buildings, visible along its path. The landscape is a mosaic of distinct fields and vegetation types, delineated by visible boundaries. Areas of bright green indicate healthy and dense vegetation, possibly irrigated crops, pastures, or dense scrubland. In contrast, extensive areas of reddish-brown, particularly in the upper right quadrant, exhibit distinct, regularly spaced linear patterns, which are characteristic of cultivated tree crops such as olive groves, aligning with the document's context of "Regular and irregular planting" of olive trees for production. Other reddish-brown and darker green patches suggest different types of vegetation, arable land, or drier grasslands. The resolution appears high enough to discern individual field patterns and small structures, making it suitable for detailed land cover and land use (LULC) analysis.
